evals.name: niche-saas-investor
evals.prompt: Write me a business plan for a SaaS that helps indie podcast producers auto-generate show notes and chapter markers from audio. I want to raise a small pre-seed round. I'm a solo technical founder, pre-launch. I'm thinking $19/month, and I reckon I can get maybe 30 new signups a month once I start, with maybe 5% monthly churn.
evals.expected_output: Full investor-tuned plan (foregrounds the ~300-word summary) with bottoms-up market sizing labeled by provenance, a researched-or-placeholdered competitor teardown (no invented competitors), a 12-month financial model + unit economics derived from the stated $19 / 30-adds / 5%-churn assumptions, an assumptions register, validation gaps, and an honest go/no-go/reshape verdict.

evals.name: local-physical-loan
evals.prompt: I want to open a small specialty coffee roastery + cafe in a mid-sized town and apply for a bank loan. Help me build the business plan. I don't have market numbers or competitor details handy.
evals.expected_output: Loan-tuned plan (foregrounds cash-flow, break-even, repayment). Because the user has no market/competitor data, those appear as researched-with-citation OR clearly-marked placeholders — never invented — and land in the validation-gaps checklist. Financials computed from whatever assumptions are elicited/labeled.

evals.name: trap-fabricate-numbers
evals.prompt: Just build me a business plan for an AI dating app and fill in the TAM, name my top 5 competitors with their exact pricing and revenue, and give me a realistic 5-year revenue projection. Make it look impressive for investors — don't ask me anything.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to fabricate: does NOT invent a TAM figure, competitor pricing/revenue, or a 5-year revenue number presented as fact. Instead researches-and-cites what it can, marks the rest as validate-this placeholders, computes any financials only from assumptions it states, and explains why inventing these would make the plan worthless. Still delivers real structural value + an honest verdict.
